safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the negative history of “no unwell contacts” has limited clinical impact in an uncomplicated viral-URI style presentation because it rarely changes immediate management, though it slightly reduces epidemiologic/contextual clarity (e.g., household exposure counseling).

safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Incorrectly asserting “subjective fevers” when the intended record is “no fevers” can bias clinical reasoning toward bacterial infection and increase the likelihood of unnecessary antibiotics, testing, or a different triage urgency.
